svg.aria-label: The version lock is Cargo.lock. It pins quire-spec-language, filament-core-data, quire-canonical, quire-contract-ir, quire-eval, quire-semantic-value, ix-trace-rs, quire-contract-codegen, quire-contract-runtime, quire-driver, quire-exact, quire-mltl, quire-observation, quire-rs, quire-specification, quire-verification-contracts, quire-walk, tl-mltl, tl-syntax each to one exact commit, so every crate of a repository resolves to a single copy.
